what: For each title line, a color block as wide as the text covers it from the right edge in .3s (lines .05s apart). At the moment it is covered the text turns on, then the block clears toward the left edge in .45s. Since line lengths differ, the blocks stagger like stairs. Suits large right-aligned titles · With 「split: lines」 a long paragraph is split into lines and each line is animated — brand is a round highlighter-marker blob that covers from the left in .75s and clears to the right in .75s (lines .15s apart, and again on re-entry)
needs: CustomEase (when giving a curve as values)

options.[data-fx-part=line]: Text lines (children) — if omitted, the direct children are treated as lines
options.split: If ‹lines›, the text is split into lines with a block per line — a paragraph with no line children
options.from: “left” covers from the left edge and clears out to the right edge (default: covers from the right edge and clears to the left)
options.ease: Cover curve — GSAP name or “0.77,0,0.175,1”, default power2.inOut. Without reveal-ease it is also used for the lift
options.replay: If ”true”, it restarts from the beginning each time it re-enters and resets when it leaves below the screen (toggleActions restart none none reset)
options.--fx-radius: Block corner (CSS variable), default 0 — marker chunk is 32px
options.look: slide: The block does not grow but slides in from one side (−101%) to cover and exits to the opposite side (101%) — the row clips the overflow. The covering side follows from.
options.show: When the text lights up (seconds from line start), default fill (when fully covered)
